summary: Tested the Trip Meal Plan / Trip Shopping List / aisle shoppers feature as Pro skipper (test_session_pro_1, boat main 'TEST_Kia Ora') on a 390x800 mobile viewport, plus the backend crew/shopping groups change. Backend: 12/12 new pytest pass (groups accepted, email HTML grouped by aisle with escaping and empty aisles skipped, 404/422/401 rules unchanged, BoatDetails.trip_meal_plan max 80). Old test_provision_shoppers.py passes 22/22; one test failed once under xdist because parallel classes write the same boat doc, and it passed on rerun. Frontend: everything in the request works except the archive reset, which I only checked in code. Details: bubble order is red 'Select Trip Meal Plan' (bg rgb 254,242,242), then 'Trip Shopping List', then 'Trip Planning'. trip-meal-dialog lists 'Meal Plan | 35 meals | MP' and 'Meal Plan - Sample | 9 meals | MPS'. Picking a plan turns the bubble green with the plan name. The clear button only shows when a plan is set and turns the bubble red again. The choice is saved on the server (DB checked, and it is back after a fresh load). The MPA opens with the Trip Meal Plan ticked and 'Sort by shopping aisle' on. Making the list went through the warnings dialog in about 15s and changed the existing list 'Trip Shopping List' to aisle headings: Fresh produce, Bakery, Meat & fish, Dairy & eggs, Pantry & dry goods, Tins & jars, Herbs/spices & sauces, Frozen. The aisle dialog lists the 8 aisles with 'n to buy' and leaves out the 'Meals (9) from' heading. The button text read 'Give Fresh produce, Bakery to TEST Free Crew'. After applying, the shopper badges show on the Trip Shopping List headings. Remaking the list with the MPA kept all 3 aisle shoppers (DB checked). On Provisions: Bread shows TEST Free Crew (Bakery), Milk shows Beta Crew (Dairy & eggs), and Ice shows nothing; the old per-item shoppers ('Someone Else', 'test free crew') no longer show. The blue 'From the Trip Meal Plan' section shows 49 meal ingredients (rgb 29,78,216), without the Provisions rows, with aisle shopper badges or 'No shopper yet'; its button opens the Trip Shopping List. Edit Item has no Shopper picker. Renaming the list to 'MPA Shopping List' in the DB: it was renamed back to 'Trip Shopping List' automatically on load. Crew window: TEST Free Crew has 'Trip Shopping List (16)' (12+4, correct) in a grey group (rgb 241,245,249) and Beta Crew has (9). Welcome Crew shows 'Nothing to buy from the Trip Shopping List' and no group. WhatsApp Copy puts the aisle-by-aisle text on the clipboard. Peek opens shop-peek-dialog with 2 aisles. Send email returned 200 to test.user.free@example.com with groups in the request.

integration_issues.issue: Send email gets 200 back, but the status line in the open crew window does not change. It still says 'list sent 5 minutes ago (changed since, send it again)', and Ready to sail stays unchanged, until the crew window is closed and opened again; then it says 'list sent just now'. Cause: `sent` comes from the crew info loaded once by CrewDialog, and SendShoppingButton never tells the parent to reload. Fix: after a successful send, call an onSent callback that reloads the crew data or changes shopping_sent locally.

issues: The grey Trip Shopping List group only uses about 55% of the card width, because the edit and remove icon column on the right takes space. So 'Send email', 'WhatsApp Copy' and 'Peek...' each wrap onto their own line and the status text wraps over 4 lines. Making the group span the full card width (below the icon column) would keep the 3 buttons on one row.
'Trip Planning' wraps onto a second line under 'Trip Meal Plan' and 'Trip Shopping List'. It is still to the right in reading order, but not on the same row. Acceptable, just noting it.
The Shopper picker is a native <select> (CookPicker), not the shadcn Select. This matches the existing Cook picker.

action_items: Update the crew card shopping status right after Send email succeeds (pass an onSent from CrewDialog that reloads the crew info or sets shopping_sent {at: now, count}).
Optional: make the grey shopping group span the full crew card width on mobile so the 3 buttons sit on one row.

Optional: restoreTrip does not bring back trip_meal_plan when an archived trip is Undone/Restored, and archiving ANY trip list (e.g. custom_trip2) clears the single boat-level trip_meal_plan. Decide whether that is intended.
critical_code_review_comments: SendShoppingButton: no refresh of `sent` after a send (see integration issue).

tripArchive.resetTrip clears trip_meal_plan whatever trip id is archived, and restoreTrip/Undo does not put it back. Aisle shoppers on the Trip Shopping List are not cleared on archive. Probably fine, but please confirm it is intended.

saveMpa remake: keeps aisle shoppers by aisle name (works), but every row gets a new id and checked state is lost. Ticks on the Trip Shopping List are wiped when the list is remade. This was the case before too, but it now matters more because the crew counts depend on unticked rows.
CrewDialog shows each crew card twice (overall list and the per-trip section), so the <prefix>-shopping-* data-testids are duplicated. Tests need .first.

The Assign shoppers people list comes from /crew-register (shopper !== false). 'Welcome Crew' (test-welcome-crew) is crew but was not offered as a shopper. That follows the register's shopper flag, which is OK if intended.
BoatPrep.jsx is 1702 lines, well over the 700-line guideline.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all features work; Send email status in the open crew window is stale)

flaky_tests: tests/test_provision_shoppers.py::TestGalleyShopperSync::test_galley_crew_sets_shopper failed once under xdist (parallel classes write the same boat doc) and passed on rerun
seed_data_creation: No seed data. Changes to test-user-pro/main, which the briefing allows: the Trip Shopping List (custom_1793492301931) was remade twice with the MPA and now has aisle headings (Fresh produce + Bakery -> TEST Free Crew, Dairy & eggs -> Beta Crew). trip_meal_plan is back to tpl_b1aef01b43 (Meal Plan - Sample), as it was. Uses: 2 Magic generations (3 left), 1 email and 2 API test emails to test.user.free@example.com. Defect I caused and fixed: a page.reload() switched the app to the pro user's Model Vessel (an app behaviour that happens before this feature), and my plan pick landed there. I reset model_vessel boat.trip_meal_plan to '' directly in the DB. I also briefly renamed the list to 'MPA Shopping List' in the DB to test the auto-rename, and the app renamed it back.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pro boat main now has an aisle-sorted Trip Shopping List with aisle shoppers. Avoid page.reload(): on reload the pro user gets switched to the Model Vessel training mode (mbp_boats_active=model_vessel); use a fresh page.goto in a new context instead. A 'Trip Planning has finished' dialog with a 'Not now' button shows on load. Crew card testids are duplicated, so use .first. Not tested: archiving a trip (so as not to archive real trip data; checked in code only), the crew-invite shopping group (the boat has no invites), and 'Assign shoppers' before a Trip Shopping List exists (it would need deleting the list; checked in code only).
rca of the issue: Stale send status: SendShoppingButton keeps only busy and peek state locally. The `sent` prop comes from CrewDialog's crew info, which is fetched when the dialog opens, and nothing triggers a reload after a successful POST /crew/shopping.
